briefing.headline: US-China model parity narrows as OpenAI and DeepSeek drop frontier updates

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier releases this week amid rising regulatory scrutiny. Compute constraints and safety concerns dominate discussions as labs push larger models.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with agentic capabilities; xAI releases Grok-3; DeepSeek-V3 matches GPT-4o performance at lower cost. Meta open-sources Llama-4-405B while Anthropic prepares Claude 4.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI chips; Microsoft announces $15B data center expansion in Texas. Google TPU v6 clusters now online in three new regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first model to exceed 10^28 FLOPs training compute trigger coordinated international safety standards?
